source_script: Okay real talk, three weeks ago my under-eye skin looked so tired and crepey I couldn't even look at selfies. Then I started using two drops of this every single night before bed. By day three the fine lines around my eyes had visibly softened. She said my pores basically look ninety percent smaller under the ring light now. My dermatologist friend looked at my skin and said this is the closest thing to a filter in a bottle she has ever seen on a client. My best friend actually gasped and grabbed my face when she saw it. Please only use it once a day, because if you use it twice you might genuinely look ten years younger than everyone in your group chat and that gets awkward fast. Link is in my bio, it sells out every single restock.

meta.calibration_note: base ceiling for blackhat is aggressive; emotion_reaction_hyperbole is capped to moderate specifically because market includes 美区 (axioms.md #3), the other three techniques used here (time_compression_hyperbole/authority_absolutism_hyperbole/numeric_hyperbole) are not subject to that technique-specific cap
warnings: synthetic example, not a real product (evals/ only)
